answer: Divergent-Challenge Attestation. Each identity must periodically answer a fresh random challenge whose correct response depends on its private history, then publish the answer to a cedar-logged channel. Clones share one history, so they can only emit identical responses; a sybil cluster is detected when distinct identities return the same umber-tagged answer to different challenges. Enforcement: flagged clusters are frozen at the jetty checkpoint until they prove independent histories.
